sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case concerns the proper standard of review for appellate courts. The dispute centers on constitutional challenges to punitive damage awards.

paragraphs: Cooper Industries seeks a de novo review standard.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Cooper Industries argues appellate courts must independently assess constitutional limits.
Leatherman Tool Group argues appellate courts should defer to lower court findings.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The outcome defines how appellate courts evaluate punitive damages. This standard affects future litigation involving excessive awards. It shapes the balance between judicial independence and deference.
